name: gowanew
description: Go WhatsApp API Gateway with Glassmorphic Web UI

scripts.start: cd src && go run -tags purego . rest
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix gowa-ui-dev run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('src/storages/ui',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('gowa-ui-dev/dist/index.html','src/storages/ui/index.html'); console.log('UI pre-seeded to src/storages/ui/index.html');"
